test_title: PYST 17: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 28 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some pages are words.

All pages are books.

All words are registers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some books are registers.

II. Some books are words.

III. All pages are registers.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow.
Only conclusions II and III follow.
Only conclusions I and III follow.

solution:
Given Statement:

Some pages are words.

All pages are books.

All words are registers.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/299fee10f4c3ff38637be942fecbf1469014afed888888f396ce5158ffa9a587.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some books are registers - **True** (Because, Those parts of books which are pages, are also parts of words, and all words are registers)

II. Some books are words - **True** (Because, Those parts of books which are pages, are also parts of words)

III. All pages are registers - False (Because, Some parts of pages which are words, are also parts of registers, so this can be a possibility only)

So, Only conclusions I and II follow.

Hence, The correct answer is **"Option (1)"**
